pathAssistantSteps.info:
Lead converted to Account, Contact, and Opportunity.

  • Verify the linked Account and Contact were created correctly
  • Review the Opportunity and set next steps

Lead does not meet qualification criteria.

  • Select a Disqualification Reason - required
  • Add any notes for future reference

New lead - gather initial details.

  • Assign to a representative
  • Gather key details from the lead's company website
  • Create a plan to build a connection

Sales Approved - lead meets qualification criteria.

  • Confirm product interest and target market
  • Obtain VP Sales sign-off
  • Prepare for conversion to Opportunity

Actively working this lead.

  • Identify the right contact
  • Save contact information
  • Execute your outreach plan
